//: Runs from plugin/ against THIS repo (see .github/workflows/publish-clawhub-plugin.yaml). `extends` scopes commit analysis + release notes to commits touching plugin/; without it commit-analyzer would read the whole monorepo history and a backend feat: would bump the plugin. Tags live in the plugin-v* namespace so they never collide with the repo-wide v* (.releaserc.json) or desktop-v* (desktop-release.yml). Conventional Commits; the default preset covers feat/fix/perf/revert and BREAKING CHANGE.
